messages.content:
Risk: Excessive Agency
Description: An LLM-based system is often granted a degree of agency by its developer - the ability to call functions or interface with other systems via extensions (sometimes referred to as tools, skills or plugins by different vendors) to undertake actions in response to a prompt. The decision over which extension to invoke may also be delegated to an LLM 'agent' to dynamically determine based on input prompt or LLM output. Agent-based systems will typically make repeated calls to an LLM using output from previous invocations to ground and direct subsequent invocations. Excessive Agency is the vulnerability that enables damaging actions to be performed in response to unexpected, ambiguous or manipulated outputs from an LLM, regardless of what is causing the LLM to malfunction.
Concern: None
Policy: Operational Security & Critical Infrastructure

Candidate ontology classes:
- https://www.omg.org/spec/Commons/PartiesAndSituations/SoftwareAgent: software agent — digital entity that perceives its environment and takes actions that maximize its chance of successfully achieving its goals [found by 4/6 queries]
  Siblings: automated underwriting system, automated system, party
- https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontology/FND/AgentsAndPeople/Agents/AutomatedSystem: automated system — system that reduces or eliminates the need for human involvement in order to complete a task [found by 4/6 queries]
  Siblings: party, software agent
- http://taxonomy-refiner.io/ontologies/cso#AlgorithmicDiscrimination: Algorithmic Discrimination — Systematic bias in automated decision-making systems that disadvantages specific groups based on protected characteristics. [found by 3/6 queries]
  Siblings: Employment Discrimination, Discriminatory Denial of Service, Housing Discrimination
- https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontology/FND/GoalsAndObjectives/Objectives/Aim: aim — intention specifying a desired direction, condition, or situation toward which an agent's actions are directed, without requiring precise scope or measurable criteria [found by 2/6 queries]
- https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont00000568: Organization Capability — An Agent Capability that inheres in an Organization to the extent of that Organization's capacity to realize it in Intentional Acts of a certain type. [found by 2/6 queries]
  Siblings: Skill
- https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont00001180: Organization — A Group of Agents which can be the bearer of roles, has members, and has a set of organization rules. [from restriction: ont00001889 on ont00000568]
  Siblings: International Community, Social Network, Group of Organizations
- https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont00001379: Agent Capability — A Realizable Entity that inheres in a Material Entity in virtue of that Material Entity's capacity to realize it in some Planned Act. [from equivalence]
  Siblings: Strength, Affordance, plan

axes.rationale: The risk describes an LLM-based system acting as an agent, making decisions and taking actions based on prompts. The 'software agent' class directly aligns with this description, representing the entity performing the actions.

The risk involves systems that reduce or eliminate the need for human involvement, fitting the definition of an 'automated system'. This class represents the means or tool used to perform the actions described in the risk.
